input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the served volume V_lab of /habitat/lab from the CO2 rise and decay with the 4 occupants as source and scrubber-1 as the pump: V = Qe * tau.

steps.why: Rise: reduce effective flow to 0.3 m3/min so CO2 climbs from 800 ppm toward a higher equilibrium (G/Qe about 5000 ppm for 4 awake occupants). 24 min keeps even a small volume (10 m3) just under 3000 ppm while a 30 m3 guess reaches about 1700 ppm. Hatch closed, held closed for the whole test.

Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min, tau = V/Qe, about 30 min for a 30 m3 first guess), record at 1 min interval; the first ~10 min (3 x 3.33 min scrubber lag) are excluded from the fit; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) with C_eq free (about 1500 ppm expected).

abort.when: the device refuses a step's speed command
a monitored person leaves 45-120 bpm, the monitoring is lost, or one more person enters or one leaves the lab

monitoring.reason: The test raises the CO2 of the air four people breathe (up to 3000 ppm).

hypotheses: Lab is one well-mixed zone; the hatch (hatch-1-v1) is held closed during the whole test and the exchange through the closed hatch to hab-b (design 3 m3/min per station-topology) is NOT measured; co2-2 in hab-b is recorded to show whether the opening exchanges air, and any such exchange would bias V_lab (apparent volume larger).
Occupants (4, awake, about 0.38 L/min each = 1.52 L/min, band 0.26-0.45) are held constant in number and activity; source G is assumed steady.
Scrubber effective flow is linear with speed: 1 m3/min at 100 percent, 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent (datasheet); its lag 3.33 min is not part of tau.
First guess V = 30 m3 (default, range 10-200) is only used to size durations; V_lab is the result of the fit, not the guess.
The start value 800 ppm is not assumed to be an equilibrium.

expected.rise: CO2 climbs from about 800 ppm to roughly 1700 ppm at the end of step 1 if V is about 30 m3 (faster, up to about 3000 ppm if V is near 10 m3; only a few hundred ppm if V is near 100 m3); never above 3000 ppm.
expected.decay: After switching to full speed, CO2 relaxes toward C_eq about 1500 ppm (G/Qe = 1.52 L/min / 1 m3/min) with tau = V/Qe, about 30 min for V = 30 m3; V_lab = 1 m3/min * tau.
expected.hypotheses_fail: If the fitted C_eq differs from about 1500 ppm by more than about 30 percent, or the rise and decay taus give V differing by more than about 25 percent, or co2-2 in hab-b moves in step with the lab, then the one-zone / closed-hatch / steady-source hypotheses do not hold and V_lab is not accepted; a refused speed command also invalidates the test.
